Proper Yokohama-style ramen in the heart of Saigon
Oct 2026 • Solo
Machida Shoten is the real deal for tonkotsu shoyu ramen. The broth is rich and creamy with a savory soy backbone, and you can customize the noodle firmness, richness, and oil level, which is a great touch. The thick, chewy noodles held up well in the soup, and the chashu was tender and flavorful. Add the seaweed and a soft egg for the full experience.

The place is clean and casual, and the staff were friendly and quick, even when it got busy. Prices are fair for the quality, though a bit above a typical local noodle shop. Portions are filling, so come hungry.

It's a great stop if you're craving Japanese comfort food in Ho Chi Minh City. I'd happily come back and try the other toppings.
